title: La última medida
logline: Un sastre y su aprendiz tienen una noche para terminar un abrigo; la costura que discuten decide si el aprendiz se queda.

beats.line: La cinta de medir se rompió a la una de la mañana.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: start on the broken measure and the unfinished coat, before we meet the two people who disagree about it
beats.transitionMotive: open on the problem, not on an establishing shot
beats.note: hook: the tailor is already at the table with the snapped measure; the line withholds who broke it

beats.line: El sastre y su aprendiz tenían hasta el amanecer para terminar el abrigo.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: cross the workroom from the old tailor to the apprentice, so the coat has a human scale and the distance between them is visible
beats.transitionMotive: the detail opens into the room; the people enter the problem
beats.note: setup: the two actors share the frame, separated by the worktable and the coat

beats.line: El aprendiz quería cerrar la costura y marcharse.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: follow the measuring cord as the apprentice reaches for it, keeping the tailor in the frame
beats.transitionMotive: cut on the hand, not on a new composition
beats.note: escalation: the apprentice reaches for the measure; the body continues from S02 instead of resetting

beats.speaker: none
beats.cameraMotive: hold the tailor's reaction; the wordless close-up is the judgement
beats.transitionMotive: hard cut to the face that has decided not to explain

actors.continuityMotive: hard cut to a close-up; the actor is reframed inside the same room, not moved in the scene

beats.note: reaction: no line; the close-up carries the refusal

beats.line: El sastre señaló la puntada que el aprendiz había saltado.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: reframe around the pointing hand until the skipped stitch becomes the subject of the two-shot
beats.transitionMotive: return to the worktable: the close-up has changed the argument

actors.continuityMotive: cut back to the worktable after the close-up; the spatial relation is declared, not inherited

beats.note: reveal: the tailor points to the missed stitch; the apprentice's state is carried from the earlier worktable

beats.line: Al amanecer, el abrigo estaba terminado; la medida también.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: release the frame until the finished coat and both people are visible in the same dawn
beats.transitionMotive: settle on the result; no new information arrives after this
beats.note: close: the coat is finished; the two actors keep their final blocking
